Compute Inter-Rater Reliability Metrics via aifeducation

Source: R/utils_performance.R
berechne_aifeducation_metriken.Rd

Computes 16 inter-rater reliability, agreement, and classification metrics for a coder training session by comparing coder ratings against gold-standard reference ratings via aifeducation::get_coder_metrics().

Usage

berechne_aifeducation_metriken(user_vals, true_vals, max_val)

Arguments

user_vals

Numeric or integer vector of coder ratings.

true_vals

Numeric or integer vector of gold-standard reference ratings.

max_val

Integer scalar giving the maximum ordinal scale value (used to define factor levels 0:max_val).

Value

A named list of rounded character metric values (accuracy, balanced_accuracy, iota_index, avg_iota2, cohens_kappa, kappa_linear, kappa_squared, fleiss_kappa, kendall_w, alpha_nominal, alpha_ordinal, gwet_ac1, gwet_ac2_quadratic, macro_precision, macro_recall, and macro_f1).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
berechne_aifeducation_metriken(c(0, 1, 2, 3), c(0, 1, 2, 3), max_val = 3)
} # }
